system.concept: Ancient barbarian warrior, killer of Gracis Nostinus's sire Marius

skills.name: Melee
skills.notes: capped for LARP play; book lists 7

system.biography:
Background

Embraced by the Roman patrician Marius around 380 A.D. as a captured barbarian chieftain, Hrothulf spent 50 years enslaved and Blood Bound to Marius, tormented and mocked for his illiteracy and "savagery" despite Marius's own reliance on Hrothulf's strength. When Marius's Blood Bond finally frayed and Marius mocked him once too often over a misread passage, Hrothulf killed him in a sudden frenzy — wounding Marius's other childe Gracis Nostinus in the same violent episode when Gracis tried to avenge his sire. Hrothulf has wandered the world since, eventually settling in Milwaukee's Outlands, an isolated home the Lupine have learned to avoid. He considers his killing of Marius a genuinely heroic act (equating Marius with history's great tyrants) and now wars quietly, subtly, with Gracis, who has never stopped seeking revenge.

Roleplaying Hints

Speaks quietly, almost shyly, with poor grammar and the occasional lapse into an ancient Germanic tongue — but his enormous physical presence means he rarely needs to raise his voice to be intimidating. Slow to anger.
system.notes: Sire/victim: Marius, killed by Hrothulf circa 412 A.D. after 50 years of Blood Bondage. Blood-brother and rival: Gracis Nostinus. Haven: a suburban home deep in the Outlands. Disciplines as printed: Animalism 3, Celerity 4, Dominate 2, Fortitude 6, Potence 4, Presence 3, Protean 3 (capped above to this system's 1-5 scale).

system.description: This fearsome mastery of Fortitude allows you to overcome one of the traditional banes of the undead: the feared stake. You may subsume a stake that pierces your heart, reshaping the dead organ around it and insulating it from the offending wood. Spend a permanent Willpower Trait and succeed in a Static Physical Challenge (nine Traits) to attempt this; if successful, spend one to five temporary Physical Traits to determine how long it takes before your body rejects the stake and you rise from immobilization: one Trait for one year, two for six months, three for one month, four for one week, five for one night. The power works the same way regardless of how many temporary Physical Traits you spend. Each use affects only one stake; if you suffer the same fate again, you may attempt this again by spending the Willpower Trait once more. If the Static Physical Challenge is lost, the body does not expel the stake, and no further attempt may be made against that particular stake. Once turned away from the heart, the stake remains lodged in your body, overgrown by dead flesh (and possibly visible beneath clothing), until you choose to cut it out, suffering two aggravated health levels of damage in the process.
system.source: Clanbook: Ventrue, Chapter Two: The King is Dead, Long Live the King
system.duration: One night to one year, depending on Traits spent

system.description: Your ability to shrug off most forms of damage has reached unbelievable heights. You may perform a Simple Test to negate nonaggravated wounds, conducting one test per wound incurred. If you win, you take no damage.

Facetiously named, this power allows the Kindred to physically knock another character away from herself with the slightest of touches. Although this power does no damage in and of itself, its use is quite humbling — to be hurled away from an elder in a social setting has its embarrassing repercussions. Some Kindred use this power surreptitiously, touching their victims and sending them reeling across the room; others use it as a not-so-subtle display of their might, giving their victim a casual slap with overwhelming results.

System: The player spends a Blood Trait and must succeed in a physical challenge to touch the target (this may be done surreptitiously, but the player may not make use of other Potence benefits). The challenge is not required if the subject allows the player to touch him (a handshake, a “friendly” hand on the shoulder, etc). This power hurls the victim 20 feet directly away from the invoking character. If the subject strikes a wall or other solid obstacle, he suffers two health levels of bashing damage. Otherwise, the character needs to win a static physical challenge against six Traits to remain standing.

With this power, the Kindred becomes capable of truly impressive physical displays. He may leap from rooftop to rooftop over entire streets, jump to a fire escape a dozen feet over his head, and perform other feats of athleticism. This is useful both for pursuit and evasion, but is quite a breach of the Masquerade should anyone see this power in use.

System: The player may use this power to allow her character to leap up to 25 feet vertically or 40 feet horizontally. She must succeed in a static physical challenge against four Traits (retest with Athletics) to land correctly — if she fails the challenge, the Storyteller should assess results as appropriate.

Assamites who hone both their preternatural senses and their speed learn a valuable secret: sometimes it is wiser to defend than to attack. A vampire with this power enters a brief trance in which she perceives every threat against her at once, assessing and reacting to each in turn.

System: At the start of a combat turn, before actions are declared, the player spends two Blood Traits and a Willpower Trait to activate this power (this counts as activating Celerity for the turn). The character takes no offensive action that turn, but may defend against every attack made against her, contesting each one individually. This power may be used no more than a number of times per scene equal to the character's Perception Trait total.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis III: Wolves at the Door, Book Two: Saracens

system.description: By spending a Blood Trait, you gain a further additional action at the end of the turn, on top of any gained from Swiftness.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines

system.description: By uttering an animal call, you summon nearby animals of a chosen type to your side, favorably disposed toward you, by spending a Social Trait per animal summoned.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
